summary: Frontend testing for Fotuber Vesikalık Faz 1 B2B additions (size library military entries, custom size, digital download, kombin layout wizard). All 7 review items PASS on /admin/vesikalik as admin with 0 console errors. Existing bg-removal/biometric flow buttons remain and no regression observed.

test_results.size_library_military_entries: PASS - Both dropdown options present: 'Türkiye — Askeri Kimlik (2.5×3.2 cm)' and 'Türkiye — Askeri Kimlik (297×378 px · dijital)'. Selecting the digital one shows note 'yalnızca dijital indirilir' and DISABLES download-sheet-btn AND quick-print-btn (both is_disabled=True).
test_results.custom_size_add_and_remove: PASS - Expanded custom-spec-panel, filled label='Test Ebat', w=30, h=40, dpi=300, clicked custom-spec-add. Entry added to dropdown, auto-selected as 'Test Ebat (30×40mm · 300dpi)', custom-spec-remove link appeared. Clicking remove deletes entry, custom-spec-remove disappears, and select falls back to 'Türkiye — Biyometrik (50×60mm)' (tr-bio).
test_results.canvas_render_after_upload: PASS - With auto-bg OFF and plain JPG uploaded via #vf, canvas-single = 591×709, canvas-sheet = 1535×2126 (non-zero).
test_results.digital_download: PASS - digital-download-btn triggered file download 'FTB00001_dijital.jpg' without any JS error.
test_results.regression_quick_print: PASS - quick-print-btn triggered toast 'Baskı penceresi açıldı'.
test_results.kombin_layout: PASS - layout-mode-kombin activates combo-builder. combo-add creates combo-item-0 and combo-item-1. Configured item-0 = Türkiye — Biyometrik (count=2), item-1 = Türkiye — Vesikalık (count=2). canvas-sheet redrew (1535×2126) with the combined layout showing both sizes + cut marks (verified visually in screenshot).
test_results.combo_margin_slider: PASS - Setting combo-margin to 5 redrew without any new console errors.
test_results.combo_print: PASS - combo-print-btn triggered success toast 'Kombin baskı penceresi açıldı' with no exception.
test_results.back_to_standart: PASS - Switching to layout-mode-standart returned normal sheet (canvas-sheet = 1535×2126).
test_results.watermark_regression: PASS - watermark-upload accepts PNG and strip controls (wm-align-left, wm-move-center, wm-move-up etc.) rendered; clicks executed without exception.

console_errors: 0 during entire flow (only pre-login /auth/me 401s and WebGL/wasm warnings from bg-removal init, unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPassportPhoto.jsx is now 1229 lines — combo/digital-export code is tightly coupled to sheet-drawing state. Consider extracting Combo builder, custom-spec form, and digital export into small hooks/components for maintainability.

In addCustomSpec, spec codes are derived from label; ensure sanitization prevents duplicate codes with different labels (currently saveCustomSpec dedupes by code, which is fine, but two labels normalizing to same code would silently overwrite).
auto-bg-toggle defaults to ON, forcing ~40MB model download on entry (pre-existing note from iter 51). Not part of this scope but user-hostile on slow networks.
In combo-spec dropdown (line 966) SelectItem shows only s.label (no dimensions) while primary select-spec shows label + dimensions. Consider unifying labels for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None (custom spec added and removed within test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Faz 1 B2B additions (military size entries, custom size localStorage, digital download exactPx+maxKb, Kombin combo layout with print) verified end-to-end via Playwright with 0 console errors. Existing bg-removal/biometric flow buttons still present; regression on sheet-download + quick-print + watermark controls confirmed clean.
